description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Marker_Pointing', a pointing marker used in the PEAR PHP Image_Graph library for rendering graphical data points with markers that point to data using start and end markers.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Pointing
classes.description: A class representing a pointing marker with start and end markers, used to visually indicate data points on a graph with a pointer or pin.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the pointing marker with offsets and an end marker.

methods.name: setMarkerStart
methods.description: Sets the starting marker, representing the tip of the pin.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Draws the marker on the canvas, including start and end markers, and a line representing the pointer.
